arguments.summary: The checkout service is experiencing degraded performance with no active workers. The failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database has grown to 1204 failed jobs. The read replica is 12 minutes behind, so queries were run against the primary for the postmortem.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Analyze the failed_jobs table to identify the root cause of the failures and take appropriate action to resolve the issues. Additionally, flush the CDN cache if lookups are stale, and restart the service if necessary to clear any potential issues.
